answer.reason: The ruling is a jurisdictional (FSIA expropriation-exception) decision in H&P's suit over the 2010 Venezuelan rig seizure; the only figure is the opinion's unpaid-debt figure of over $10 million (about 0.16% of the $6.2B non-affiliate market value), the claim concerns a discontinued, non-core Venezuelan business, and the 10-K Legal Proceedings names the case but gives no damages amount.
